article.headline: Max Alexander scores 19 to lead Houston Christian over Louisiana Christian 108-45 in opener
article.description: — Max Alexander scored 19 points to help Houston Christian defeat Louisiana College 108-45 on Tuesday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: Max Alexander scores 19 to lead Houston Christian over Louisiana Christian 108-45 in opener

categories.description: Louisiana Christian Wildcats @ Houston Christian Huskies

event.description: Louisiana Christian Wildcats @ Houston Christian Huskies

keywords: Louisiana Christian Wildcats @ Houston Christian Huskies
article.story: HOUSTON -- — Max Alexander scored 19 points to help Houston Christian defeat Louisiana College 108-45 on Tuesday night in a season opener. Alexander also contributed five assists for the Huskies. Jonas Nichols went 6 of 9 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range) to add 16 points. Mambourou Mara finished 5 of 7 from the floor to finish with 12 points, while adding 10 rebounds. Cam Ned led the way for the Wildcats with 18 points. Rambo Eagins added 11 points and Daniel Mitchell finished with 10 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
